about_the_game:
Witchcrafter The TCG Has Arrived!
Step into the ultimate edition of the competitive card game that's been evolving lately.
Challenge top Duelists from around the globe and rise to the top!

Prepare yourself—It’s time to Duel!

About Witchcrafter The TCG

The beloved Witchcrafter The TCG is now available in a full-fledged digital format!
Enjoy fast-paced Duels anytime, anywhere—with stunning HD visuals and an electrifying new soundtrack.
Take on challengers worldwide in this definitive card battle experience!

Duel Your Way—Anytime, Any Skill Level

Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned strategist, Witchcrafter The TCG welcomes all players.
Start your journey with a ready-to-play deck, and unlock powerful new cards as you progress.
Customize, enhance, and dominate!

Rotating Tournaments & Special Formats

Put your deck-building and Dueling skills to the test with a wide variety of tournaments and events.
With over 2,000+ unique cards and rotating rulesets, no two tournaments are ever the same.
Choose your format, craft your winning deck, and claim your spot at the top!

Discover the Lore Behind the Cards

Explore the rich storylines behind your favorite cards in Solo Mode.
Perfect for newcomers, returning players, or lore lovers, this mode sharpens your skills while immersing you in the Witchcrafter The TCG universe.

Origin of Witchcrafter The TCG

Witchcrafter The TCG, created by Fok Tsz Lam, debuted in Spear Group Limited’s Year of TCG (2024) and quickly became a hit board game. Riding on its success, Spear Group expanded the franchise with trading card and console game adaptations, captivating a global audience with its distinctive world and thrilling gameplay.

Recommended For:

  • Trading Card Game enthusiasts

  • Players who thrive in competitive strategy games or board games

This game offers in-game purchases, including virtual currency for acquiring randomized in-game items.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or AMD Athlon 64x2 5600+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 420 or ATI™, Radeon™ HD 6850 or Intel® HD Graphics 4000 or better with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 2GB of video memory + 4GB of system memory required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: 2.4 Ghz i5 or greater or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 650 or AMD HD 5850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Witchcrafter The TCG is the definitive cross-platform strategy card game — featuring lightning-fast Duels, stunning HD visuals and versatile board game play rules! Prepare to test your skills against Duelists from around the globe!
